required_config_changes: gwp_limit_overall=0 (or very small e.g. 100 ktCO2/y for numeric safety)
expected_impact: Very tight constraint. May cause infeasibility if model cannot decarbonize heavy industry and transport within cost-optimal technology portfolio. Solver may need long time or fail.
scientific_justification: Finland Carbon Neutrality Act (2035 target). However, Finland's policy target considers LULUCF sinks not modeled in ESMC, so true 'net-zero' in ESMC (which only models energy-system emissions) would be overly strict.
notes: Risk: infeasibility. May need to allow small residual emissions. ESMC does not model LULUCF.

expected_impact: Should be more feasible than 2035 net-zero due to lower technology costs and higher technology maturity in 2050 dataset. But same LULUCF caveat applies.
scientific_justification: EU Climate Law (net-zero by 2050). Widely used constraint in ESMC thesis (fossil-free scenarios).  Thesis uses fossil-fuel import ban rather than GWP cap (see §4 p.135).
notes: Thesis approach was fossil-free (ban imports) not GWP cap. Consider both.

description: Progressive 2035: moderate GWP cap (e.g. 15000 ktCO2/y ≈ 60% reduction from 2017 level of 41200 ktCO2/y)
expected_impact: Medium constraint. Should be feasible — allows continued fossil use at reduced level. More realistic for 2035 given short transition time.
scientific_justification: Finnish government's medium-term climate plan targets ~60% reduction in non-ETS sectors by 2035 vs 2005. Energy-sector CO2 was ~41 MtCO2 in 2017.
notes: Moderate approach — good for feasibility testing before tightening.

expected_impact: Allows small residual emissions from waste incineration and process heat. More solver-friendly than strict zero.
scientific_justification: Practical interpretation of EU Climate Law allowing small residual emissions balanced by sinks. Numeric safety margin.

description: Reproduce thesis approach: fossil-free (ban fossil imports)
required_config_changes: Set avail_exterior=0 for GASOLINE DIESEL LFO JET_FUEL GAS COAL (via patch). gwp_limit_overall=None.
expected_impact: Removes all fossil fuel availability. Very strong — model must find renewable/nuclear alternatives for all energy. May be infeasible for single-country FI without electricity imports.
scientific_justification: Direct replication of thesis methodology (Ch.4 p.135): 'no_imports' list bans all fossil fuels. Nuclear can stay.
notes: User chose gwp_limit_overall approach instead of fossil-fuel ban.

description: Brownfield 2035: raise f_min for techs with committed pipeline
required_config_changes: Patch: WIND_ONSHORE f_min=0.496→3.0 GW (Finland has 6.9 GW installed 2024), WIND_OFFSHORE f_min=0→1.6 GW (committed projects), PV_ROOFTOP f_min=0→0.8 GW, PV_UTILITY f_min=0→0.5 GW
expected_impact: Forces model to install at least these capacities. Reflects sunk costs and committed projects. Reduces solution space — faster solve.
scientific_justification: IEA/IRENA statistics: Finland had 6.9 GW wind (2024), ~0.8 GW rooftop PV (est). Fingrid pipeline shows 1.6 GW offshore committed by 2030. For 2035, at least current installations should exist.
notes: User confirmed. Exact values to be set in patch files.

description: Brownfield 2050: same as H06 but with higher wind floor
required_config_changes: Patch: WIND_ONSHORE f_min=0.496→5.0 GW, WIND_OFFSHORE f_min=0→3.0 GW, PV_ROOFTOP f_min=0→2.0 GW, PV_UTILITY f_min=0→2.0 GW
expected_impact: Same effect as H06 but assumes more installations locked in by 2050.
scientific_justification: Plausible extrapolation: by 2050, Finland's wind fleet should be well above current levels. Lower bound represents irreversible investments.
notes: User confirmed. Exact values to be set in patch files.

description: Cap f_max for numeric safety: reduce 1e15 to reasonable upper bounds
required_config_changes: Patch: all techs with f_max=1e15 → f_max=100 GW for power, 1000 GW for storage, 50000 Mpkm/h for transport
expected_impact: Improves solver numerics significantly (barrier crossover stability). May slightly change results if model tried to install >100 GW of anything (unlikely for single-country FI).
scientific_justification: CPLEX barrier solver known to have stability issues with mixed large/small coefficients. 163/167 REF_REGION techs have f_max=1e15.
notes: User: 'it has been done this way for MultiCell version should not be a problem'. Leave 1e15 as-is.

description: NUCLEAR: keep thesis bounds (4.36–5.0 GW) vs relax for SMR
required_config_changes: Option A: keep f_min=4.36 f_max=5.0 (thesis default — existing fleet). Option B: f_max=7.0 to allow NPP expansion or SMR. REF_REGION has NUCLEAR_SMR technology.
expected_impact: A: Model keeps current fleet, no new nuclear. B: Allows 2 GW expansion — significant low-carbon baseload.
scientific_justification: Finnish energy policy allows new nuclear. Olkiluoto 3 (1.6 GW, 2023) already in f_min. Hanhikivi 1 project cancelled (2022). SMR interest growing.
notes: Decision linked to policy assumption. Thesis keeps nuclear fixed at current capacity.

description: RE share primary energy target: 50% for 2035
expected_impact: Forces at least 50% of primary energy from renewables. May conflict with nuclear and biomass classification.
scientific_justification: Finland NECP target: 51% RE in gross final energy by 2030. For 2035, 50% primary is conservative.
notes: ESMC RE share is primary energy basis, not final energy. Need to verify accounting.

description: RE share primary energy target: 80% for 2050
expected_impact: Strong RE target. Combined with GWP cap, may over-constrain the problem.
scientific_justification: EU-wide target for near-full decarbonization. 80% RE primary is consistent with net-zero.  May be redundant if GWP cap is strict enough.
notes: Consider whether GWP cap alone is sufficient or RE share adds value.

description: Adjust DHN heat share for Finland
required_config_changes: Patch to FI/Misc.json: share_heat_dhn_min=0.10 share_heat_dhn_max=0.50 (vs REF default 0.02–0.37)
expected_impact: Widens DHN solution space. Finland has extensive DHN infrastructure (~46% of heat).
scientific_justification: Finnish Energy Authority: ~46% of building heat from DHN (2023). Current Misc.json inherits REF default (Belgium-based 2-37%). FI-specific bounds needed.
notes: REF_REGION Misc.json sets share_heat_dhn_min=0.02 and max=0.37. FI/Misc.json does NOT override these. For Finland, 0.37 max may be too low.

description: Grid losses: use 2035/2050 default (4.7%) or Finland-specific value
required_config_changes: Keep default (4.7% in Misc_indep.json) vs patch to 4.0% (Finnish grid is efficient)
expected_impact: Minor impact on total system cost and electricity balance.
scientific_justification: Finnish grid losses ~5% historically (2017 calibration used 5.0% after v36 correction). 2035 default is 4.7% which is reasonable for future Finnish grid.
notes: Current 2035/2050 Misc_indep.json already has 4.7%. Thesis EU-average. Acceptable for Finland.

expected_impact: Constrains technology market shares. Was critical for 2017 calibration (wood boilers, coal). For future: may be less relevant but prevents unrealistic dominance.
scientific_justification: 2017 calibration required fmin_perc to match reality (DEC_BOILER_WOOD, COAL_US). For future years without reality reference, fmin_perc is a modeling choice about technology diversity.
notes: Default in thesis run_esmc.py is f_perc=False. Default in run_calib_manual.py is f_perc=True. For future baselines, start with False (thesis approach).

description: Allow electricity imports from exterior (avail_exterior for ELECTRICITY)
required_config_changes: Patch: Resources.csv ELECTRICITY avail_exterior=0→10000 GWh/y (or larger)
expected_impact: Opens electricity import as a resource. Reflects Finland's interconnections (Nordic grid, Baltic). May significantly reduce system cost.
scientific_justification: Finland imports ~20 TWh/y of electricity (2017). Single-cell model with avail_exterior=0 forces domestic production of all demand. This is the thesis default for multi-cell (imports come from other cells). For single-cell FI: need to model imports explicitly.
notes: User confirmed: allow trade. Exact avail_exterior value TBD in patch file.
